mapper.select: SELECT * FROM repair_worker WHERE crew_id = #{crewId} AND is_active = 1
SELECT * FROM repair_worker WHERE is_active = 1 AND is_online = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO repair_worker (worker_code, worker_name, crew_id, skills, phone, is_online, current_tasks, max_tasks, is_active) VALUES (#{workerCode}, #{workerName}, #{crewId}, #{skills}, #{phone}, #{isOnline}, #{currentTasks}, #{maxTasks}, #{isActive})
mapper.update: UPDATE repair_worker SET current_tasks = current_tasks + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND current_tasks < max_tasks
UPDATE repair_worker SET current_tasks = GREATEST(current_tasks - 1, 0) WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE repair_worker SET is_online = #{isOnline} WHERE id = #{id}
